questions.question: OP-01/O119 (AX-6, close-out): on an Open stream the caller calls write(1), then seek('x'). D117 raises a caller error first, while D154 and D161 raise io.UnsupportedOperation. Which comes first?

options.label: Unsupported first (Recommended)
options.description: An unsupported method checks no argument. On an Open, Exhausted or Failed stream it raises io.UnsupportedOperation whatever its arguments, and on a Closed one it raises as D164 sets it. D117's rule that a caller error comes first covers the methods the stream supports. This amends D117 only. It matches io as run (CPython 3.13.18, non-seekable BufferedReader) for write, seek and truncate, but not for writelines(1), where io raises TypeError.

options.label: Caller error first
options.description: D117 holds for every method: an invalid argument raises TypeError or ValueError before io.UnsupportedOperation. This amends D154, D161 and D164, and departs from io for write, seek and truncate.

options.label: Per method, as io
options.description: Each method follows io as run: write, seek and truncate raise io.UnsupportedOperation first, and writelines raises a caller error first. This amends D117 and D161 with a per-method list.

questions.question: OP-01/O120 (AX-11, close-out): D35 says the open call 'makes its first backend request there', and D89 says 'a whole read's one request included'. NP2 leaves request counts unpromised. Are D35's and D89's request counts promises or reasons?

options.label: Reasons, as D160 (Recommended)
options.description: D35 promises where the classification failures surface (the open call), and 'makes its first backend request there' becomes its reason. D89 reads 'a whole read included', which states its exposure, not a count. The request count is NP2's. This amends D35 and D89, and NP2 keeps one scope, as D160 and D165 decided.

options.label: Promises, NP2 narrowed
options.description: D35's one request at open and a whole read's one request are promised, and NP2 gains rows that except them. A check that counts two requests fails. This amends D41 and conflicts with D73, D78 and D79's retried whole read.

options.label: Route to spec flow (Recommended)
options.description: Each note reads 'Routed to OP-01's spec flow by OP-01/D179.' and blocks nothing. The spec flow writes each clause once and cites the note it settles, as D156, D163 and D175 did.

options.label: Decide each here
options.description: Each note is decided now as an amendment to its decisions, in another dialog.
